title: RawTelemetryEvent
description: Catch-all for telemetry that doesn't cleanly fit alert/process/network/auth/file — e.g. generic syslog lines, unparsed PCAP summaries, or a new source that hasn't had an adapter written for it yet. This is the escape valve that keeps ingestion from blocking on schema coverage: anything can land here unparsed, and get reclassified later once a real adapter exists. Should shrink over time as adapter coverage grows, not grow indefinitely as a dumping ground.

message.description: Best-effort human-readable summary line, if the adapter could extract one.

raw.description: The full original payload. Required (not optional) here, unlike other event classes, since this class's entire purpose is preserving data the canonical schema couldn't yet structure.
